title: Joaquin Fernandez Tapia
text:
I work at the intersection of mathematics and practical decision-making under uncertainty. My experience spans quantitative finance, real-time bidding, credit, fraud, and business performance — covering stochastic modelling, forecasting, experimentation, and policy design.
I write up the technical notes I keep for myself — on experimentation design, optimization and stochastic modeling — when they turn out useful enough to share. See Projects & Articles for the polished ones and Blog for looser, occasional notes.

title: Joaquin Fernandez Tapia
text:
Experience
Lead Core Data Analytics · Betclic Group — France January 2026 – Present

Built a reusable performance-analytics and forecasting capability, establishing an explainable business-as-usual baseline from seasonal patterns and sports-calendar data.
Piloting a shared performance-review operating model with an analytics team to validate the framework and clarify decision ownership.
Leading a company-wide experimentation workstream — governance and tooling recommendations.

Lead Data Scientist, Fraud Platforms · Nubank — São Paulo, Brazil November 2023 – October 2025

Led a from-scratch initiative to redesign how fraud features and analytics were developed and delivered across Data Science, platform teams, and internal users.
Reframed a graph-analytics platform into a production system for fraud-model features and policies.
Introduced embedding-based detection to surface emerging fraud patterns earlier.

Lead Business Analyst, Fraud Defenses · Nubank — São Paulo, Brazil May 2021 – October 2023

Owned fraud policy across onboarding and transactional fraud, balancing losses against customer friction and operational cost.
Led the transition to real-time policy, migrating rules and models to transaction time.
Led business-risk evaluation and policy strategy for identity verification (face match, liveness, A/B testing).

Lead Business Analyst, Credit Collections · Nubank — São Paulo, Brazil November 2019 – April 2021

Built communications, campaign and offer strategy across the debt-collections journey.
Ran controlled A/B experiments on communication journeys and pricing; led uplift modeling.
Led analytics for collections policy — KPIs, roll-rate monitoring, cohort analysis, survival curves.

Quantitative Research · HSBC — Paris September 2017 – September 2019

Applied reinforcement learning to optimal execution (tactical limit- and market-order placement).
Developed a generative model for financial time-series simulation.
Studied hedging under transaction costs; contributed to a peer-reviewed publication.

Quantitative Analyst, Programmatic Advertising · Tradelab — Paris July 2014 – September 2016

Designed an automated campaign-management system for ad-buying prices, budget pacing and allocation.
Implemented a multi-armed bandit algorithm in production for real-time campaign optimization.

Quantitative Research · Kepler Cheuvreux — Paris September 2011 – September 2014

Modelled optimal execution and market making using stochastic control, with explicit trade-offs among market impact, inventory risk and timing risk.
Statistical analysis of market-microstructure and order-book data.
